description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'PayGradeController' within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component called 'pay-grade-list' in its preRender method. It is part of the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, specifically handling the pay grade management functionality.

classes.name: PayGradeController
classes.description: A controller class for managing pay grades in the OrangeHRM admin interface. It extends AbstractVueController and initializes a Vue component on pre-render.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the 'pay-grade-list' Vue component before rendering the page.
